title: slim-credential-wave-adapter-and-stream-consumer-polish
author: Ava Patel
release_notes: Add credential-wave fallback adapter; unify retry presets; add pause/resume stream helpers; bump SDK versions: python 2.5.0, typescript 1.14.0, go v1.10.0.
description: Context: SDK parity and ergonomics sprint focused on auth/retry behaviors and streaming consumer stability across Python/TypeScript/Go. Motivation: reduce cognitive surface for application teams by introducing a small opinionated credential fallback path when primary token refresh fails, stabilize stream consumer pause/resume semantics, align default retry presets across languages, and publish coordinated minor version bumps to signal ergonomic improvements. Summary: introduce a 'credential-wave' adapter that stages fallback credentials, exposes a simple degradation policy and emits structured telemetry; add lightweight stream-consumer helpers (peek/pause/resume) with consistent semantics across py/ts/go; centralize retry presets ('low_latency','balanced','throughput') and wire them into SDK constructors; add unit and integration tests, docs and changelogs; bump package versions. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-3412) [x] cross-sdk unit/integration tests added [x] telemetry events documented [x] changelogs updated [ ] e2e with Dedicated planned as follow-up. Commits summary: introduce credential-wave adapter and base interface; stream-consumer helpers and retry presets; docs and changelogs + version bumps. Changed areas: auth adapters under sdk/*/auth, stream helpers under sdk/*/stream, retry presets in common config, docs in docs/sdk and root CHANGELOG. Review thread: Diego: "Can we call the API pause()/resume() or will that collide with existing sync iterables?" Author: "renamed to pauseConsumer()/resumeConsumer() and added small shim for older names with deprecation warning". Diego: "Please add an explicit telemetry tag for fallback reason so SRE can filter events". Katherine: "TS unit saw occasional generator teardown races; suggest small delay on close path or stronger handshake". Author: "added a robust close handshake and an integration test that simulates rotation and partitioning". CI: initial run had one flaky TS unit (generator teardown) and a lint formatting failure; fixes pushed and final CI green. QA: stress harness run for 12h against local runtime with token churn, observed stable reconnects, no memory leaks. Merge: squashed and merged on 2025-11-15, merge commit 4a7b93c1d2e8f6a9bce3f1d. Rollout: publish packages over next 48 hours, push docs site update, and coordinate example repo updates. Related work: ENG-3445, SUP-1219.
